proof_attempt_summary: D0 derived the componentwise sign-ratio closure, conditional-positive-density attainment construction, cycle/Farkas and LP/MILP certificates, strict support and pin gaps, and primitive-inversion/oracle arguments. The field package failed because full published-class attainment is refuted by an in-scope binary-treatment law and the adaptive selector is not computable from abstract C1 regularity alone; several local duality, zero-stratum, tuning, citation, and witness repairs also remain before the sound conditional result could be reused as a subfield paper.
tldr: Positive bounded ratios of omitted-variable biases force one globally compatible, common-sign bias vector on each connected setting component, with the all-zero vector as a closure face.  The resulting affine product of two-polyhedron unions is the exact causal effect set on the published Huntington--Klein specialization \(0<\ell_{jk}\le1\le u_{jk}\), whereas the published pairwise bias-difference polytope is generally only an outer set.  Algebraic containment continues to hold for the project-maintained generalized positive-ratio class.  Converse attainment now uses the unified construction \(A_i^B=U_i+B_iD_i\), which preserves the entire observed joint margin and proves pointwise sharpness whenever each conditional pair \((D_i,U_i)\mid X\) has an everywhere-positive density and finite second moments; nonsingular conditional-Gaussian laws are an immediate corollary.  The paper also supplies log-cycle and Farkas certificates, exact branch-linear-program and zero-safe mixed-integer computation, strict support and requested-pin gaps, and a solved three-setting cycle.  For estimated supershort calibration, undivided primitive-moment inversion is uniformly valid at exact zero, \(n^{-1/2}\)-weak denominators, and branch or basis ties.  A calibrated-sieve split-sample handle falls back to that inversion near singularities and selects numerical-delta inference on certified safe cells, giving uniform coverage and pointwise first-order recovery of the known-cell oracle at every fixed strict regular law.

A single procedure that adapts between these regimes remains the first-class open problem.
